name: Summer Scholars Program
focus: Nine-week paid pediatric research internship; first-time research interns are prioritized.
notes: Strong stipend and explicitly friendly to students without much research experience. 2026 cycle: opened Nov 17, apps due Jan 2, letters due Jan 16.

name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
focus: Independent research in basic and cancer biology at Fred Hutch.
notes: PERFECT TIMING FIT: restricted to rising seniors, which is precisely her junior summer. 2026 deadline was Jan 9. Fred Hutch said 2027 info posts in November. Early deadline — do it in the December block.

name: Broad Summer Research Program (BSRP)
org: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
focus: Nine weeks of genomics, cancer and neuroscience research at one of the strongest genomics institutes in the world.
notes: 2026 cycle closed Jan 11 with letters due Jan 13. A third-party listing shows an anticipated 1/11/27. Early deadline — do not let this one slip behind the February cluster.

name: INSPIRE — Investigating Neurosciences Summer Program
org: Indiana University School of Medicine (Stark Neurosciences)
focus: Alzheimer's disease and neurodegeneration research in the Stark Neurosciences Research Institute.
notes: 2027 applications were slated to open in October 2026 — worth checking right now.

name: MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP)
focus: Nine weeks of research in MIT labs with heavy graduate-school preparation.

name: Summer Research Program in Academic Medicine
category: Academic medical centers & med school SURPs
focus: Research and clinical exposure across IU School of Medicine.
notes: Same institution as INSPIRE on her original list — she may be able to be considered for several IU tracks at once. Ask the program coordinator.

name: Undergraduate Research Program (URP)
focus: Ten fully subsidized weeks of research at a legendary molecular biology institute, ending in a formal presentation.
notes: Deadline has been Jan 15 in both 2025 and 2026, so mid-January 2027 is a safe planning assumption. Enormous prestige for a PhD-track application.

name: Newborn Medicine Summer Student Research Program
org: Boston Children's Hospital / Beth Israel Deaconess
focus: Neonatal and newborn medicine research for undergraduates and medical students.
notes: 2026 cycle: applications due Jan 23, letters due Jan 30. A second Boston Children's door beyond the epilepsy lab.

name: Summer Student Program (SSP)
city: Bar Harbor, ME and Farmington, CT
focus: Ten weeks of genetics and genomics research with an independent project and a written report — unusually strong mentorship structure.
notes: CONFIRMED DATE: Jan 25, 2027 at 5pm ET. Best total compensation package on this whole list — stipend plus room, board and travel. Applications open November 2026.

name: Emergency Department Clinical Research Internship
focus: Hands-on pediatric emergency medicine clinical research — patient enrollment and data collection in the ED.
notes: Unusually strong clinical-contact experience for a pre-med application — real patient interaction, not just bench work. Most recent published cycle was summer 2024, so confirm it is still running.

name: Summer Internship Program
focus: Large-scale brain science and computational neuroscience.
notes: Excellent pay. Leans computational — a fit if she has any coding or data analysis background. Pairs with Seattle Children's for one city.

name: AHA Undergraduate Summer Fellowship (AHA-USF)
focus: American Heart Association-funded cardiovascular and stroke research.
notes: Same institution as SURIP — one visit, two applications.

name: Amgen Scholars Program (US)
city: Multiple (Caltech, Columbia, Duke, Harvard, Hopkins, UCLA, UCSF, UNC, UT Southwestern, WashU, Yale and more)
focus: Premier national undergraduate research program with a shared symposium; each host institution runs its own application and its own labs.
notes: BEST VALUE PER UNIT OF EFFORT. She can apply to as many US hosts as she likes, and much of the essay content is reusable across them. Applications open Nov 1, 2026; a third-party guide puts the deadline at Feb 1, 2027 for all US hosts — confirm per host.

name: BioMedRAP — Biomedical Research Apprenticeship Program
category: Academic medical centers & med school SURPs
focus: Nine weeks of biomedical research with graduate-school preparation at WashU Medical School.
notes: WashU is also an Amgen Scholars host.

name: CHOP Research Institute Summer Scholars Program (CRISSP)
focus: Mentored pediatric biomedical research with a cohort seminar series.
notes: One of the most competitive pediatric programs in the country.

name: CURE Summer Program (Continuing Umbrella of Research Experiences)

notes: Pairs with Boston Children's, which is adjacent — one Boston trip, several applications.

name: Cancer-focused Summer Undergraduate Research (CanSUR)

name: College COACH Program
focus: Paid ten-week undergraduate research internship placed across hospital departments.
notes: Runs on a short, unusual timeline: an interest form around mid-December, then individual department postings in early January, decisions in March. Watch it weekly rather than waiting for one deadline.

name: Equity Summer Research Program
category: Academic medical centers & med school SURPs

notes: Pairs with Doernbecher Children's Hospital for a pediatric angle.

name: Maryland Center for Developmental Disabilities / research internships

notes: Worth knowing: MSK's better-known HOPP Summer Student Program is high-school only (2027 deadline Feb 5). MBSP is the undergraduate one — the original list had the right one.

name: Pediatric Oncology Education (POE)
focus: Pediatric cancer and catastrophic disease — basic, translational, or clinical placements.

name: Pediatric Research Summer Program

tracks: basic-science, translational, clinical, neuroscience, oncology, pediatrics

notes: HIGHEST PRIORITY ADD. Single application, enormous number of labs, and she can email individual PIs directly to boost her odds — that outreach is what actually gets people placed. 2026 cycle closed Feb 18; 2027 expected to open mid-November 2026 and close mid-February 2027. Verify at training.nih.gov/sip.
